# Casa Maria Beach Villa

> An intimate luxury beachfront private villa and staycation sanctuary in Barangay Amunitan, Gonzaga, Cagayan, Philippines. Featuring 4 private bedrooms (including 1 master suite), dual-pool courtyard, direct beach proximity, and exclusive buyout hospitality for 8 to 16 guests.

Casa Maria Beach Villa is an exclusive coastal sanctuary in Gonzaga, Cagayan, designed for discerning travelers, families, and private groups seeking complete seclusion, effortless relaxation, and bespoke hospitality along northern Luzon's pristine coast.

## Quick Facts
- **Property Name**: Casa Maria Beach Villa
- **Brand / Domain**: casamariaph.com
- **Location**: Barangay Amunitan, Gonzaga, Cagayan 3513, Philippines
- **Google Maps Plus Code**: 83J6+75M Amunitan, Gonzaga, Cagayan
- **Google Maps Pin**: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=83J6%2B75M+Amunitan%2C+Gonzaga%2C+Cagayan
- **Accommodation Model**: Entire Villa Buyout (100% private; only one group hosted at a time)
- **Maximum Capacity**: 8 to 16 guests
- **Bedrooms**: 4 private bedrooms including 1 spacious Master Bedroom with vaulted timber ceilings
- **Bathrooms**: Modern Carrara-style marble en-suite spa baths with rainfall shower fixtures
- **Check-in**: 2:00 PM (14:00)
- **Check-out**: 12:00 PM (12:00 Noon)
- **Beach Proximity**: 2-minute stroll to the serene Amunitan shoreline

## Features & Amenities
- **Private Swimming Pools**: Illuminated two-tier courtyard swimming pool with multi-color LED mood lighting.
- **Panoramic Living & Dining**: Open-concept salon featuring floor-to-ceiling glass sliding doors opening to the pool deck.
- **Hospitality & Service**: Attentive on-site caretakers, daily housekeeping, and personalized stay assistance.
- **Connectivity**: Free high-speed fiber Wi-Fi throughout indoor and outdoor pool living areas.
- **Compound Security**: Fully gated estate with private on-site parking and 24-hour estate security.
